alt: December 2025 calendar page: a watercolour of a decorated Christmas tree with a gold star in a cosy living room, wrapped presents beneath it and a snowy view outside. Christmas is marked.
caption: A watercolor illustration of a decorated Christmas tree with gifts below in a cozy room, set above a calendar for.
description: This watercolor page features a stylized Christmas tree adorned with gold and red ornaments and a star on top, standing on a rug surrounded by wrapped presents. The scene is set in a warm interior with a large window, a chair, and framed artwork on the walls. Below the illustration is a printed calendar grid for December 2025, with the 25th labeled as Christmas.
